composites.name: membrane-demo-with-viz
composites.description: Mem3DG membrane demo with wired Visualization Steps. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the scalar energy/area/volume trajectories (MembranePlots) and a three.js orbitable 3D mesh viewer (Membrane3D), each written to its own store.

interval.description: Process interval in Mem3DG time units.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.

viz_3d_title.description: Title for the three.js 3D mesh viewer.

composites.name: membrane-patch
composites.description: Membrane patch bulging: a flat hexagonal membrane with fixed boundary edges is inflated by constant osmotic pressure, forming a dome. Models local membrane deformation such as bleb formation or pressure-driven bulging in confined geometries.

interval.description: Process interval in Mem3DG time units. Demo runs use 40 (total_time=1000 / n_snapshots=25); the lower default keeps dashboard test-runs fast.

osmotic_model.description: Osmotic model — 'constant' applies a fixed baseline pressure.

osmotic_pressure.description: Constant osmotic pressure (used when osmotic_model = constant).

boundary_condition.description: Boundary condition — 'fixed' pins boundary vertices in place.

composites.name: membrane-deflation
composites.description: Osmotic deflation: a spherical vesicle (icosphere) deflates to 50% of its initial volume under harmonic osmotic pressure. Bending rigidity maintains the smooth spherical shape as the membrane contracts. Models osmotic shock in biological vesicles.

interval.description: Process interval in Mem3DG time units. Demo runs use 20 (total_time=500 / n_snapshots=25); the lower default keeps dashboard test-runs fast.

preferred_volume_fraction.description: Target volume as a fraction of initial volume (0.5 = 50%).

composites.name: membrane-demo
composites.description: Mem3DG membrane mechanics demo: an icosphere relaxes under bending rigidity, surface tension, and osmotic pressure. Bundles two Visualization Steps: MembranePlots (Plotly time-series of energies/area/volume) and Membrane3D (three.js orbitable mesh viewer).

interval.description: Process interval in Mem3DG time units. The Euler integrator marches in characteristic_timestep increments to fill this window.

subdivision.description: Icosphere subdivision level. Higher = finer mesh, slower per step.

preferred_volume_fraction.description: Fraction of initial volume used as the preferred-volume target.

viz_title.description: Title for the Plotly time-series figure.

viz_3d_title.description: Title for the three.js 3D mesh viewer.

composites.name: membrane-tube
composites.description: Tubular constriction: a cylindrical tube narrows uniformly as osmotic pressure drives volume reduction to 60% of its initial value. Pinned boundary conditions hold the ends. Models membrane tubule dynamics in endoplasmic reticulum networks.

interval.description: Process interval in Mem3DG time units. Demo runs use 60 (total_time=1500 / n_snapshots=25); the lower default keeps dashboard test-runs fast.

preferred_volume_fraction.description: Target volume as a fraction of initial volume (0.6 = 60%).

boundary_condition.description: Boundary condition — 'pin' fixes the tube end caps.
